newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Bell Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Bell Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 Q4 includes a gain of $13.2 million related to lump-sum pension payouts and charges of $3 million related to acquisitions, for a net benefit of $10.2 million, which increased net income by $6.6 million, or $0.10 a share.

1996 year includes gain of $27.4 million for pensions and nearly offseting gains related to reversals of accruals and charges related to acquisitions, for a net benefit of $27.1 million, which increased net income by $17.4 million, or $0.26 a share.
Excluding gains, Q4 net income was $45 million or $0.65 a share and 1996 net income was $167.6 million or $2.44 a share.

1995 Q4 includes charges of $73.5 million which reduced net income by $60.9 million or $0.92 a share. Excluding these charges, 1995 Q4 net was $32.4 million or $0.49 a share. 1995 year includes charges of $208.0 million. which reduced net income by $146.5 million or $2.21 a share.

1995 special items included restructuring charges, writeoff of unamortized goodwill, debt refinancing and other non-recurring charges. Excluding these items, 1995 net was $114.2 million or $1.72 a share.
